# Rohnit Roy

> Rohnit Roy is a multi-disciplinary product designer and AI Evangelist based in Pune, India, building software solutions and modern interfaces. He is AI Evangelist & Consultant at Fluid.Live, Co-founder & CTO of MelloMinds, and a guest lecturer in Artificial Intelligence at IMED (Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University), Pune.

Focus areas: design, experience, AI.

## Quick facts

- Name: Rohnit Roy
- Based in: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Role: Product designer, AI Evangelist & Consultant, startup co-founder, AI guest lecturer
- Current work: Fluid.Live (AI Evangelist, Aug 2025 – present), MelloMinds (Co-founder & CTO), IMED BVDU (Guest Lecturer, Aug 2026 – present), RudraX Aerospace (UAV IP, testing and development, Aug 2026 – present)
- Education: MCA (2024 – 2026) and BCA (2021 – 2024), IMED, Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University, Pune
- Website: https://rohnitroy.vercel.app/
- Contact: rohnitroy.corp@gmail.com

## What he does now

- **AI Evangelist & Consultant at Fluid.Live**: advises organizations on AI adoption and data readiness; delivered 40+ enterprise consultations in 2025. Prototypes practical AI workflows, including local offline model stacks with MCP servers and automated short-form ad content pipelines.
- **Co-founder & CTO at MelloMinds**: an AI SaaS that helps mental health professionals manage their therapy practice efficiently, with Fort Knox-like security.
- **Guest Lecturer at IMED (BVDU), Pune**: teaches Theory of Artificial Intelligence to BCA Semester V students.
- **RudraX Aerospace**: works with government and public-sector ventures on the IP, testing and development of UAVs and tactical UAV modules.

## Career timeline

- **2019**: Co-founded Digitalite Solutions™, a creative marketing agency in Pune that served 100+ brands in social media and influencer marketing (Aug 2019 – Dec 2021).
- **2020**: Led one of Digitalite's largest campaigns, engaging 15,000+ influencers across India for a single client.
- **2021–2022**: Built a B2B ecosystem for the retail industry that helped 1,000+ retailers go digital.
- **2023**: Co-founded AdoSolve InfoTech Pvt. Ltd. (Dec 2023), a tech and content company that became an AI-as-a-Service venture; from 2025 it developed and deployed AI products with Fluid.Live. Stepped down in Aug 2026. Also Non-Executive Director at RN Roy Food & Hospitality LLP (Jun 2023 – present).
- **2023–2026**: Built YaatriAI at AdoSolve, an AI platform that plans and optimizes vacations and road trips by building travel itineraries.
- **2026**: Started MelloMinds LLP and began teaching AI/ML to undergraduate students in Pune.

## Certifications
